name: eiasc-cril
description: EIASC Community Registration & Institutional Licensing Platform

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @eiasc/api && npm run build --workspace @eiasc/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @eiasc/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @eiasc/web
scripts.db:apply-registration-payments: prisma db execute --schema prisma/schema.prisma --file prisma/migrations/20260912100000_registration_payments/migration.sql && prisma db execute --schema prisma/schema.prisma --file prisma/migrations/20260912110000_registration_payment_settings/migration.sql
scripts.db:bootstrap: npm run db:deploy && npm run db:apply-registration-payments && npm run db:seed && npm run db:import-geography && npm run db:verify-geography
